translations.title: Acetaminophen 325 mg Soft Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for fever and pain from a cold, headache, nerve pain, muscle pain, period pain, sprain pain, toothache and joint pain.
translations.usage: Adults and children 12 or older take two capsules three to four times a day, every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Do not take more than 12 capsules (4 g) in one day. Take the lowest dose for the shortest possible time.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to it, if you have a peptic ulcer, a severe blood disorder, severe liver or kidney problems, severe heart failure, aspirin-induced asthma, or if you drink alcohol. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, talk to a pharmacist before taking it. If you drink alcohol regularly there is a risk of liver damage, so get advice. Do not take it together with other products that contain acetaminophen, barbiturates or tricyclic antidepressants. Get advice if a fever lasts more than 3 days or pain more than 10 days.
